mandelbug.explanation: Each source has its own loading/error/stale state. Combined they create 256 possible UI states — most untested.
mandelbug.suggestion: Model combined state explicitly with a single loading/error barrier component.

mandelbug.title: `consensus_signals_ws` awaits 9 services sequentially
mandelbug.explanation: Sequential awaits across 9 services create a 9-way error/timeout interaction space. Any combination of partial failures yields a different emergent outcome.
mandelbug.suggestion: Use asyncio.gather() for independent calls; add explicit timeout + fallback per service.

race_condition.explanation: If the component unmounts or deps change before the fetch resolves, the callback still fires and calls setState on an unmounted component — classic race condition.
race_condition.suggestion: Add AbortController; return () => controller.abort() in cleanup.

schrodinbug.suggestion: Add a Zod schema or runtime type guard before the cast.

schrodinbug.title: `or` default clobbers valid falsy value
schrodinbug.explanation: `x or default` replaces 0, False, '' — valid values — with the default.
schrodinbug.suggestion: Use `x if x is not None else default` for non-None checks.
